integrity: The infinite statement is proved directly from the published exact tile-count formulas and the published compositeness of a+b. The bundled finite enumeration is used only as a stress test. The arithmetic examples 21 and 143 are explicitly not presented as geometric tiling constructions.
scientific_limitations: The result is a necessary arithmetic sieve and does not assert existence for the semiprime arithmetic candidates.
It covers only the four nonisosceles incommensurable 2pi/3-tile cases of Beeson Theorems 18--21.
It does not classify tile counts with larger prime-factor multiplicity.
title: Semiprime bottlenecks in the four nonisosceles 120-degree triangle-tiling cases
